ConfigMapEntry.description:
One row of a flow's `config_map`: a user-facing flow-config key is
forwarded into `target` block's config under `key`.

key.description: Key within the target block's config to populate.

FlowConfig.description:
Flow-level execution policy: a timeout, a step budget and an error
policy that wrap the whole step sequence rather than any single step.
Set at most one of `timeout` and `timeout_ms`.

max_steps.description:
Cap on the number of step executions, to prevent infinite loops.
Defaults to 1000.

on_error.description: How the runtime reacts when a step errors. Defaults to `"stop"`.

timeout.description:
Human-readable timeout (e.g. `"30s"`) — alternative to `timeout_ms`: a
whole number followed by `ms`, `s`, `m` or `h` (a bare number is
seconds), at most 24h.

timeout_ms.description: Hard timeout for the entire flow, in milliseconds (at most 24h).

NextEntry.description:
A routing rule in a step's `next` list: when `when` evaluates to true,
jump to `step` (within this flow) or `flow` (a different flow id). An
entry without `when` is the default fallthrough.

flow.description: Target flow id to hand control over to.

step.description: Target step id within the current flow.

when.description: Optional `when` expression. Omit for the default fallthrough entry.

OnError.description: What the runtime does when a step returns an error.

oneOf.description: Stop the flow and return the step's error.
Record the failed step's output as `null` and run the next step.

ParallelBranch.description:
One branch of a step's `parallel` fan-out: an ordered list of steps that
executes concurrently with its sibling branches.

steps.description: Ordered steps run within this branch.

PortSchema.description:
JSON Schema subset used to describe typed flow / step ports.

Mirrors a handful of JSON Schema keywords (`type`, `properties`, `items`,
`required`, `default`, `description`) — enough for the introspection UI
without pulling in a full schema library.

default.description: Default value supplied when the caller omits this field.

properties.description: For `object` schemas, the property-name → sub-schema map.

required.description: For `object` schemas, the list of required property names.

Step.description:
A single step in a flow — one block invocation plus its input template
and (optionally) the routing rules for the next step.

config.description:
Per-step block config for this invocation only (overrides flow- and
instance-level config).

description.description: Human-readable description shown in introspection endpoints.

each.description:
`$.path` to an array: the step's block runs once per item, in order,
with `$.each.item` and `$.each.index` set.

id.description:
Step identifier unique within the flow (`input` and `each` are
reserved); also the key under which the step's output is stored, so
later steps read it as `$.<id>.<field>`.

input.description:
JSON template passed to the block as input. String values starting
with `$.` are resolved against the accumulator at execution time.

next.description:
Conditional routing entries evaluated in order; the first whose
`when` is true (or the lone default entry) wins.

parallel.description:
Parallel branches, run concurrently before the step's own block;
their accumulator entries are merged once all of them finish.

description: A declarative flow: metadata, typed input/output ports, the ordered steps to execute, and optional flow-level config.

blocks.description:
Names of the blocks this flow depends on. Informational: the runtime
resolves blocks from the steps, not from this list.

config.description: Optional flow-level execution policy (timeouts, step budget, error handling).

config_defaults.description:
Config merged into other blocks' configs, keyed by block name. Applied
together with `config_map`: only when the flow declares a `config_map`
and config is registered under the flow's id.

config_map.description:
Declarative config routing: maps user-facing config keys to
`(target block, key within that block's config)` pairs so a flow
can expose a flat config surface that fans out to its component blocks.

description.description: Free-form description shown in introspection endpoints.

id.description: Stable identifier for the flow (used by the runtime registry).

input.description: JSON Schema describing the data the caller must supply as `$.input`.

name.description: Human-readable name displayed in admin UIs and logs.

output.description: JSON Schema describing the value returned to the caller.

steps.description:
Ordered list of steps; execution starts at `steps[0]` unless a
`next` entry redirects.

version.description: SemVer string for the flow definition itself (not the runtime).

title: WaferFlow
